# CANDIDATE: VIX_CONTANGO_PULLBACK_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Elevated near-term VIX futures (contango) often precede a mean-reverting bounce after a short-term pullback to the VWAP or rising EMA ribbon. This setup aims to capture the bounce by going long when we see VIX contango (VIX1D/VIX ratio > 1.05) and a pullback to VWAP or EMA ribbon with bullish confirmation.

## Mechanism

Entry: When the VIX1D/VIX ratio > 1.05 (contango) AND price pulls back to within 0.2% of the VWAP (or touches the 20-period EMA if the ribbon is bullish: 5-EMA > 20-EMA > 50-EMA) AND the bar closes bullish (close > open) with volume >= average 5-min volume, go long at the close.  
Exit: Stop set at the low of the pullback bar; target 1 at 1.5R; if price reaches 2R without hitting stop, switch to a chandelier trail (ATR(2) x 2.5) to let a runner run.  
Regime: Ideal during mid-morning (10:00-12:00 EST) when VIX is low-moderate (<20) and the market is not in a strong trend (ribbon spread < 0.15%); avoid during high-impact news or when VIX > 25 (panic).
